name: Kontoor Brands (KTB)
teaser: Wrangler and Helly Hansen earn about $465 million of EBITDA and the Lee sale should bring roughly $600 million of cash. My Base is $80.99, 11.0% above $72.94: a fair price for a good business. Hold, with a maximum buy price of $48.60.
llms: Branded jeans, workwear and outdoor apparel group (Wrangler, Helly Hansen; Lee being sold to Authentic Brands Group for $750 million cash plus an earnout of up to $250 million), fiscal year ending around December 31. Valued on 2026 EBITDA after stock pay for the continuing business (primary, 60%) with the estimated Lee net cash added and net debt subtracted, cross-checked with price to normalized free cash flow (40%); values are fair value today as of October 15, 2026. Main finding: the screen yield of over 10 percent on trailing free cash flow includes 123 million dollars of working capital release and Lee; normalized free cash flow is about 298 million dollars, a 7.4 percent yield. Bear $53.70, Base $80.99, Bull $108.73. Verdict HOLD at $72.94 (Confidence C, required margin of safety 40%), maximum buy price $48.60.
